text.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلْمُدَّثِّرُ

translations.asad: O THOU [in thy solitude] enfolded!
translations.sahih: O you who covers himself [with a garment],

translations.asad: Arise and warn!
translations.sahih: Arise and warn

translations.asad: And thy Sustainer's greatness glorify!
translations.sahih: And your Lord glorify

translations.asad: And thine inner self purify!
translations.sahih: And your clothing purify

translations.asad: And all defilement shun!
translations.sahih: And uncleanliness avoid

translations.asad: And do not through giving seek thyself to gain,
translations.sahih: And do not confer favor to acquire more

translations.asad: but unto thy Sustainer turn in patience.
translations.sahih: But for your Lord be patient.

translations.asad: And [warn all men that] when the trumpet-call [of resurrection] is sounded,
translations.sahih: And when the trumpet is blown,

translations.asad: that very Day shall be a day of anguish,
translations.sahih: That Day will be a difficult day

translations.asad: not of ease, for all who [now] deny the truth!
translations.sahih: For the disbelievers - not easy.

translations.asad: LEAVE Me alone [to deal] with him whom I have created alone,
translations.sahih: Leave Me with the one I created alone

translations.asad: and to whom I have granted resources vast,
translations.sahih: And to whom I granted extensive wealth

translations.asad: and children as [love's] witnesses,
translations.sahih: And children present [with him]

translations.asad: and to whose life I gave so wide a scope:
translations.sahih: And spread [everything] before him, easing [his life].

translations.asad: and yet, he greedily desires that I give yet more!
translations.sahih: Then he desires that I should add more.

translations.asad: Nay, verily, it is against Our messages that he knowingly, stubbornly sets himself
translations.sahih: No! Indeed, he has been toward Our verses obstinate.

translations.asad: [and so] I shall constrain him to endure a painful uphill climb!
translations.sahih: I will cover him with arduous torment.

translations.asad: Behold, [when Our messages are conveyed to one who is bent on denying the truth,] he reflects and meditates [as to how to disprove them] –
translations.sahih: Indeed, he thought and deliberated.

translations.asad: and thus he destroys himself, the way he meditates:
translations.sahih: So may he be destroyed [for] how he deliberated.

translations.asad: yea, he destroys himself, the way he meditates!
translations.sahih: Then may he be destroyed [for] how he deliberated.

translations.asad: and then he looks [around for new arguments],
translations.sahih: Then he considered [again];

translations.asad: and then he frowns and glares,
translations.sahih: Then he frowned and scowled;

translations.asad: and in the end he turns his back [on Our message], and glories in his arrogance,
translations.sahih: Then he turned back and was arrogant

text.arabic: فَقَالَ إِنْ هَٰذَآ إِلَّا سِحْرٌۭ يُؤْثَرُ

translations.asad: and says, "All this is mere spellbinding eloquence handed down [from olden times]!
translations.sahih: And said, "This is not but magic imitated [from others].

translations.asad: This is nothing but the word of mortal man!"
translations.sahih: This is not but the word of a human being."

translations.asad: [Hence,] I shall cause him to endure hell-fire [in the life to come]!
translations.sahih: I will drive him into Saqar.

translations.asad: And what could make thee conceive what hell-fire is?
translations.sahih: And what can make you know what is Saqar?

translations.asad: It does not allow to live, and neither leaves [to die],
translations.sahih: It lets nothing remain and leaves nothing [unburned],

translations.asad: making [all truth] visible to mortal man.
translations.sahih: Blackening the skins.

translations.asad: Over it are nineteen [powers].
translations.sahih: Over it are nineteen [angels].

text.arabic: وَمَا جَعَلْنَآ أَصْحَٰبَ ٱلنَّارِ إِلَّا مَلَٰٓئِكَةًۭ ۙ وَمَا جَعَلْنَا عِدَّتَهُمْ إِلَّا فِتْنَةًۭ لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لِيَسْتَيْقِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُوا۟ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ وَيَزْدَادَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ إِيمَٰنًۭا ۙ وَلَا يَرْتَابَ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُوا۟ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ وَٱلْمُؤْمِنُونَ ۙ وَلِيَقُولَ ٱلَّذِينَ فِى قُلُوبِهِم مَّرَضٌۭ وَٱلْكَٰفِرُونَ مَاذَآ أَرَادَ ٱللَّهُ بِهَٰذَا مَثَلًۭا ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ يُضِلُّ ٱللَّهُ مَن يَشَآءُ وَيَهْدِى مَن يَشَآءُ ۚ وَمَا يَعْلَمُ جُنُودَ رَبِّكَ إِلَّا هُوَ ۚ وَمَا هِىَ إِلَّا ذِكْرَىٰ لِلْبَشَرِ

translations.asad: For We have caused none but angelic powers to lord over the fire [of hell]; and We have not caused their number to be aught but a trial for those who are bent on denying the truth - to the end that they who have been granted revelation aforetime might be convinced [of the truth of this divine writ]; and that they who have attained to faith [in it] might grow yet more firm in their faith; and that [both] they who have been granted the earlier revelation and they who believe [in this one] might be freed of all doubt; and that they in whose hearts is disease and the who deny the truth outright might ask, "What does [your] God mean by this parable?" In this way God lets go astray him that wills [to go astray], and guides aright him that wills [to be guided]. And none can comprehend thy Sustainers forces save Him alone: and all this is but a reminder to mortal man.
translations.sahih: And We have not made the keepers of the Fire except angels. And We have not made their number except as a trial for those who disbelieve - that those who were given the Scripture will be convinced and those who have believed will increase in faith and those who were given the Scripture and the believers will not doubt and that those in whose hearts is hypocrisy and the disbelievers will say, "What does Allah intend by this as an example?" Thus does Allah leave astray whom He wills and guides whom He wills. And none knows the soldiers of your Lord except Him. And mention of the Fire is not but a reminder to humanity.

translations.asad: NAY, but consider the moon!
translations.sahih: No! By the moon

translations.asad: Consider the night when it departs,
translations.sahih: And [by] the night when it departs

translations.asad: and the morn when it dawns!
translations.sahih: And [by] the morning when it brightens,

translations.asad: Verily, that [hell-fire) is Indeed one of the great [forewarnings] –
translations.sahih: Indeed, the Fire is of the greatest [afflictions]

translations.asad: a warning to mortal man –
translations.sahih: As a warning to humanity -

text.arabic: لِمَن شَآءَ مِنكُمْ أَن يَتَقَدَّمَ أَوْ يَتَأَخَّرَ

translations.asad: to everyone of you, whether he chooses to come forward or to hang back!
translations.sahih: To whoever wills among you to proceed or stay behind.

translations.asad: [On the Day of Judgment,] every human being will be held in pledge for whatever [evil] he has wrought –
translations.sahih: Every soul, for what it has earned, will be retained

translations.asad: save those who shall have attained to righteousness:
translations.sahih: Except the companions of the right,

translations.asad: [dwelling] In gardens [of paradise], they will inquire
translations.sahih: [Who will be] in gardens, questioning each other

translations.asad: of those who were lost in sin:
translations.sahih: About the criminals,

translations.asad: "What has brought you into hell-fire?"
translations.sahih: [And asking them], "What put you into Saqar?"

translations.asad: They will answer: "We were not among those who prayed;
translations.sahih: They will say, "We were not of those who prayed,

translations.asad: and neither did we feed the needy;
translations.sahih: Nor did we used to feed the poor.

translations.asad: and we were wont to indulge in sinning together with all [the others] who indulged in it;
translations.sahih: And we used to enter into vain discourse with those who engaged [in it],

translations.asad: and the Day of Judgment we were wont to call a lie –
translations.sahih: And we used to deny the Day of Recompense

translations.asad: until certainty came upon us [in death]."
translations.sahih: Until there came to us the certainty."

translations.asad: And so, of no benefit to them could be the intercession of any that would intercede for them.
translations.sahih: So there will not benefit them the intercession of [any] intercessors.

translations.asad: WHAT, THEN, is amiss with them that they turn away from all admonition
translations.sahih: Then what is [the matter] with them that they are, from the reminder, turning away

translations.asad: as though they were terrified asses
translations.sahih: As if they were alarmed donkeys

translations.asad: fleeing from a lion?
translations.sahih: Fleeing from a lion?

text.arabic: بَلْ يُرِيدُ كُلُّ ٱمْرِئٍۢ مِّنْهُمْ أَن يُؤْتَىٰ صُحُفًۭا مُّنَشَّرَةًۭ

translations.asad: Yea, everyone of them claims that he [himself] ought to have been given revelations unfolded!
translations.sahih: Rather, every person among them desires that he would be given scriptures spread about.

translations.asad: Nay, but they do not [believe in and, hence, do not] fear the life to come.
translations.sahih: No! But they do not fear the Hereafter.

translations.asad: Nay, verily, this is an admonition –
translations.sahih: No! Indeed, the Qur'an is a reminder

translations.asad: and whoever wills may take it to heart.
translations.sahih: Then whoever wills will remember it.

text.arabic: وَمَا يَذْكُرُونَ إِلَّآ أَن يَشَآءَ ٱللَّهُ ۚ هُوَ أَهْلُ ٱلتَّقْوَىٰ وَأَهْلُ ٱلْمَغْفِرَةِ

translations.asad: But they [who do not believe in the life to come] will not take it to heart unless God so wills: [for] He is the Fount of all God-consciousness, and the Fount of all forgiveness.
translations.sahih: And they will not remember except that Allah wills. He is worthy of fear and adequate for [granting] forgiveness.
